parameters.query:
SELECT id, topic, language, target_duration_seconds, status, tts_synthesis_count
FROM public.jobs
WHERE id=$1
  AND status='queued'
  AND tts_synthesis_count=0;

UPDATE public.jobs
SET script_text=$2,
    script_json=$3::jsonb,
    status='script_ready',
    updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1
RETURNING id AS job_id, script_text, target_duration_seconds, language;

UPDATE public.jobs
SET tts_synthesis_count=tts_synthesis_count+1,
    status='tts_in_progress',
    updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1
  AND tts_synthesis_count=0
  AND status='script_ready'
RETURNING id AS job_id, script_text, target_duration_seconds, language, tts_synthesis_count;

UPDATE public.jobs
SET audio_path=$2,
    audio_sample_rate=$3,
    audio_channels=$4,
    audio_mime_type=$5,
    status='voice_ready',
    updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1
RETURNING id AS job_id, status, audio_path, audio_sample_rate, audio_channels, tts_synthesis_count;
